{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_enrolled_patients = df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()

# Print the number of unique patients after deduplication
print(num_enrolled_patients)"}
